card.name: Linking words before dose-related terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, and, a, an, be, causes) in toxicology and safety text, right where the next word is likely 'dose' or 'concentration' (e.g. 'dose-related', 'in a dose-dependent fashion').

modes.label: Before dose-related
modes.description: A link word just before 'dose-related' or 'dose-dependent' describing an increase in findings.
modes.example: there was a statistically significant<< and>> dose-related increase in the incidence of malignant

modes.label: In vitro test settings
modes.description: A link word in genotoxicity test descriptions, where a concentration or test system is expected next.
modes.example: It was clastogenic<< in>> the in vitro Chinese hamster lung cell

card.writes: It boosts 'concentration' and 'dose' words as the next word, and lowers 'medium'.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come right before 'dose-related' or 'concentration' in animal and lab study text.
